parameters.description:
Send an SMS to your own D7 Networks account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-d7networks-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your D7 Networks account — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional D7 Networks accounts bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"message_globals":{"channel":"sms","originator":"${ customer_secrets.D7NETWORKS_SMS_FROM }"},"messages":[{"recipients":["${ customer_secrets.D7NETWORKS_SMS_TO }"],"content":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and ": " or "")..(_body.body or "")) *},"data_coding":"auto"}]}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment D7 Networks destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to D7 Networks messages/v1/send
